content.text:
I submitted index 0 (Sb fraction 0.055) as the best composition. At 0.064% it had the highest EQE of the five I measured. All values are small.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 0.055 | 0.064 |
| 4 | 0.080 | 0.054 |
| 9 | 0.142 | 0.047 |
| 15 | 0.259 | 0.044 |
| 24 | 0.516 | 0.036 |

EQE dropped steadily as the Sb fraction rose, so the Y-rich end of the line looks best. I used the last measurement on index 9 to check for a peak at middle Sb fractions; it came in lower, which supports the trend.

- **Gaps:** I didn't measure the neighbours of index 0 (indices 1–3) or anything above Sb 0.52 (indices 25–28). One of those could still beat index 0.
- **No structure data:** I didn't use any XRD or the structure and band-gap tools, so I can't say which crystal phase is responsible.
